evidence.text: Expand the metric in a formal amplitude ξ through second order. Linearized Einstein equations determine the waves; quadratic terms define the averaged effective stress tensor ⟨Tμν⟩ = −κD⁻¹⟨Gμν^(2)[g^(1)]⟩. The averaging over several wavelengths and the overall minus sign are explicit parts of the prescription.

sources.title: The dark bubbleography

sources.title: On The Stability Of Non-Supersymmetric AdS Vacua

evidence.text: Construct the four-dimensional Kähler potential and flux superpotential, extremize the scalar potential, and examine canonically normalized moduli/axion mass matrices against the BF bound. Blow-up effects are expanded in δ=√|eA³/(e1e2e3)|, retaining their leading stabilizing potential.

sources.title: Generalized surface tension bounds in vacuum decay

evidence.text: The generalized wall action is obtained by matching bounce and false-vacuum subtraction regions at equal ρ. Large-radius scaling factors out the inner wall area. A kink virial relation and an integrated total-derivative identity connect the two thin-wall tensions to the general bound.

sources.title: Occurrence of semiclassical vacuum decay

evidence.text: Numerically evolve the radial classical equation φ̈ = φ″ + (2/r)φ′ − dV/dφ, with φ′(t,0) = 0, while scanning Gaussian amplitude A and width R. The paper reports implementing the simulations in Mathematica 11.3.0.

sources.title: Schwinger effect and false vacuum decay as quantum-mechanical tunneling of a relativistic particle

evidence.text: Estimate prefactors using translation zero modes and dimensional analysis rather than evaluating the full fluctuation determinants. The omitted center-of-mass spatial contribution is restored by hand.

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric heterotic strings on $AdS_{4}\times S^{3}\times S^{3}$

evidence.text: Reduce to a four-dimensional Einstein-frame potential, include the genus-one cosmological constant, and solve the background equations. Linearize the ten-dimensional equations and expand fluctuations in scalar, transverse-vector and tensor harmonics on both spheres.

sources.title: On The Stability Of Non-Supersymmetric AdS Vacua

evidence.text: Use Coleman–De Luccia thin-wall bounces and compare the calibrated lower bound TL=2e^(K/2)|ΔW| with the gravitational ceiling. A finite AdS-to-AdS bounce requires T<√(4/3)(√|V−|−√|V+|); for a small energy difference this gives TU≈ε/√(3|V0|). Holomorphic wrapped cycles can saturate TL.

sources.title: Catalytic creation of baby bubble universe with small positive cosmological constant

evidence.text: How do black holes and string clouds alter gravitational vacuum-decay bounce actions, and can their catalytic effect favor creation of a four-dimensional bubble with a very small positive cosmological constant?

sources.title: Dynamics of false vacuum bubbles in Brans-Dicke theory

evidence.text: Can different Brans–Dicke field values inside and outside a thin false-vacuum bubble produce negative effective shell tension and expanding bubbles visible to an exterior observer, beyond the Einstein-gravity solutions considered by the authors?

sources.title: An Obstacle to populating the string theory landscape

evidence.text: Can coupled scalar dynamics make vacuum bubbles singular, obstructing eternal inflation from populating flux vacua, and what potential conditions permit regular solutions?

sources.title: The Role of Microstate Degeneracy in Phase Transitions: Gravitational Waves from Bubble Entanglement

evidence.text: How does a large degeneracy of internal bubble microstates affect first-order-transition nucleation, the quantum state and evolution of materialized bubbles, and the gravitational radiation from their mergers?

sources.title: Bubble of nothing decays of unstable theories

evidence.text: Can bubbles of nothing survive stabilization of a compact dimension at positive vacuum energy, and how does their tunneling exponent behave as the false-vacuum energy approaches zero?

sources.title: Gravitational effects on and of vacuum decay

evidence.text: How does gravitation alter semiclassical false-vacuum nucleation and subsequent bubble growth, and how does the change in vacuum energy alter spacetime inside and outside the bubble?

sources.title: Tunneling with negative tension

evidence.text: Can negative-tension walls mediate vacuum decay in otherwise perturbatively stable theories, and does the fluctuation spectrum exclude apparently acausal bubble nucleation?

sources.title: Cosmic Bubble Collisions

evidence.text: How do bubbles form and collide in false-vacuum eternal inflation, and which collision effects could be observable in cosmology? This is an introductory, deliberately noncomprehensive review with one proposed new spacetime solution.

destination.title: Bubbles of nothing and boundary universes
destination.question: Under which definitions, compactification conditions and boundary prescriptions can spacetime decay to nothing or nucleate a boundary universe from nothing?
destination.summary: Preserves forward decay, reverse creation and ETW cosmology as related but non-equivalent targets. Renormalization and the selected compactifications are essential distinctions.

systems: A dS4 ETW boundary of an AdS5 region
targets: Reverse creation and definitions of nothing
Renormalized comparison with the infinitely negative AdS limit
regimes: One-sided boundary nucleation and a limiting two-sided description
assumptions: Definitions of nothing are not interchangeable without a comparison
The ETW equivalence is a source claim with a specified renormalization prescription
conventions: The apparent infinite negative ETW tension is an unrenormalized intermediate result
A de Sitter foliation of a decay geometry does not establish a phenomenological wall universe
excludes: A universal instability theorem for all AdS compactifications
Unqualified creation from any proposed meaning of nothing
